correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the exact cubic edges u_i-u_(i+1), u_i-v_i, v_i-v_(i+2) and the multiplicity-aware reflected quotient neighbor multisets. The six-round base and induction split the three-orbit leading collision while advancing the resolved frontier two indices each round; the four mod-4 seam cases leave a nontrivial collision at R-1 and resolve it at R. Reflection invariance plus singleton orbit-sized final cells proves the full rooted automorphism-orbit statement. Independent full-graph WL, BFS/eccentricity and orbit computation for every n=14..150 (137 parameters) agreed; further independent full-graph wavefront/seam checks on n=26..250 (225 parameters, 6,666 wavefront-round comparisons) agreed. The tests are finite corroboration; the explicitly examined induction is necessary for n unbounded.
